releases.title: Complete Toolbox Guided Tour
features: The Toolbox information tour now follows every visible mini-app from the top-left tile to the bottom-right tile.
All 12 Toolbox tiles are included: MeasureMate, MaterialMate, DrawingMate, CADMate, Skills Card, NoteMate, the learning-hours tool, ProjectMate, ReviewMate, RemindMate, FeedbackMate and Settings.
Each step highlights one exact tile and scrolls the phone preview to keep that tile visible.
Numbered guide titles make the full sequence and current position clear.
items: Fixed the outdated Toolbox guide that skipped CADMate, Skills Card and FeedbackMate and used the wrong tile order.

releases.title: Monthly Reminder Trigger Fix
features: The Open Portfolio reminder now appears immediately after a complete monthly portfolio download is recorded.
Returning to Apprentice+ from the browser, download screen or another app forces an outstanding reminder check.
The one-minute reminder cycle remains active until Open Portfolio and Uploaded online? are completed.
Give me an hour still pauses the current reminder stage for a full hour.
items: Fixed the V1.3 issue where the reminder could remain waiting for a background timer that mobile browsers had suspended.

releases.title: Monthly Upload Reminders
features: Monthly upload reminders only begin after a complete course portfolio ZIP has downloaded successfully.
The first reminder prompts the learner to open their saved online portfolio link.
After opening the portfolio, the reminder changes to Uploaded online? with a Yes, all done confirmation.
Both reminder stages include Give me an hour for offline work or continued evidence capture.
Unsnoozed reminders are checked every minute and remain visible on the Course screen until completion.
Confirming the upload clears the reminder and establishes the next NEW-evidence baseline.
items: The reminder state is saved on the device, so closing and reopening Apprentice+ does not remove an outstanding upload requirement.

releases.title: Complete Monthly Course Portfolio
features: Every monthly upload ZIP now contains the whole course portfolio rather than only assignments changed since the last upload.
All course assignments are included every time, together with every saved evidence pack, PDF, photo, video, voice recording and RPL record currently held on the device.
The Academy PDF now contains the learner's complete saved test and Knowledge Slide history, with NEW labels on activity completed since the previous confirmed upload.
The learning-hours PDF now contains the complete OTJ or GLH history on every upload.
NEW evidence stamps and the Monthly Summary continue to identify only evidence, KSBs or LOs, RPL, learning hours and Academy activity added since the last confirmed upload.
The complete coursework restore file remains included in every monthly ZIP.
items: A monthly ZIP can now replace the previous online portfolio copy in full while retaining a clear audit of what is new this month.

releases.title: Restore Coursework
features: Added Restore Coursework to the password-protected Admin Mode.
Every monthly portfolio ZIP now includes a compressed ApprenticePlus-Coursework-Restore.aplus recovery file.

The recovery file preserves learner details, selected course, all course evidence, Academy and EPA test history, RPL, ReviewMate, OTJ or GLH activity, settings, college branding and separately stored recordings.
A learner can select their latest monthly ZIP on a blank or replacement device and restore the complete Apprentice+ installation.
Restore validates the backup before making changes and requires two confirmations before replacing local data.
After a successful restore, Apprentice+ restarts using the recovered learner profile and coursework state.
items: Existing monthly evidence PDFs and organised portfolio files remain unchanged alongside the new recovery file.

releases.title: ReviewMate+ Meetings and GLHMate
features: Added ReviewMate+ as a second ReviewMate tab for conducting and recording the complete learner progress-review meeting while preserving the existing live-target workflow.

ReviewMate+ automatically compares the current portfolio with the previous signed review to show progress gained, new evidence, newly completed KSBs or Learning Outcomes, learning-hours activity, Academy results and previous targets completed or outstanding.

Review meetings capture attendance, reviewer and employer details, learner voice-to-text reflection, employer comments, barriers, support actions, the next five weekly ReviewMate targets and both learner and employer signatures.
Every completed meeting is retained in dated ReviewMate+ history and produces a professional signed single-page A4 review PDF.

Learning Outcome courses now show a fixed GLHMate shortcut in the Course title tile and use GLHMate, GLH and guided-learning wording throughout the learner-facing hours workflow; apprenticeship-standard courses remain OTJMate.

Learning Outcome Video Walkthrough now records video instead of audio and uses the same responsive recorder, landscape layout, compact prompt drawer, gallery fallback, review controls and saved-video presentation as the KSB walkthrough.
Every LO walkthrough tile shows the Learning Outcome code and official wording, and submitted attempts remain available for playback, replacement and new walkthrough versions.
Legacy audio accidentally saved in the LO Video Walkthrough is preserved by moving it into Professional Discussion and no longer counts as video evidence.
LO progress, planner and ReviewMate calculations now count only genuine walkthrough video and use the correct Supporting Evidence section.
LO Video Walkthrough PDFs and portfolio ZIPs now list and export genuine videos without blank audio-only assessor, activity or signature fields.
Fixed technical-drawing PDF creation and switched packaged drawings to local offline files instead of an external repository.
Fixed assignment knowledge-assessment loading and ReviewMate retake routes by loading and caching the question bank and assessment engine.
Fixed restored navigation state and completed an offline asset, manifest, KSB-course and LO-course runtime audit.
Added one identical-media blocker across every course, assignment, evidence pack and formal photo or video evidence route.
Duplicate checking compares the actual processed media content rather than the filename, so renaming the same photo or video does not bypass the check.
The blocker covers KSB and Learning Outcome photographs, practical and observation photographs, KSB and Learning Outcome walkthrough videos, and supporting-evidence photos or videos.
Previously saved legacy evidence is checked as well as new evidence, including walkthrough clips stored separately for reliable mobile playback.
When identical media is found, the learner sees where it has already been evidenced, including the course, AS or EP, evidence type and linked KSB, Learning Outcome or evidence filename.
Multiple files selected together are checked against each other, while replacing the existing media in the same unsent evidence slot remains allowed.
First-time learner setup now displays every learner profile field immediately and requires the learner to actively choose a course before continuing.
No course is preselected on a new installation, preventing learners from accidentally starting with the wrong assignments or criteria.
ReviewMate targets are now scheduled in order: Target 1 is due after one week, Target 2 after two weeks, through to Target 5 after five weeks.
Every weekly ReviewMate reminder includes all incomplete targets, while completed targets are automatically excluded from the following week.
Outstanding targets keep repeating until the next 8, 10 or 12-week review is saved; the previous reminder set is then retired and preserved in dated review history as reset.
Added ReviewMate as a new Productivity miniapp in the Toolbox.
ReviewMate reads live assignment, KSB or Learning Outcome, OTJ, Academy, EPA, evidence-balance and portfolio-upload data.
Every saved review contains exactly five automatically prioritised targets, with incomplete KSBs or Learning Outcomes considered before broader progress actions.
Targets can identify one-of-two KSB evidence gaps, Learning Outcome evidence gaps, near-complete assignments, low or failed Academy results, OTJ shortfalls, EPA practice and portfolio uploads.
When a learner relies much more on photographs than video, ReviewMate can target a full linked video walkthrough.
Failed Academy results point first to the matching Knowledge Slides and then to a retake for a Pass; passed results can target Merit or Distinction.
Each ReviewMate target has a Go button that opens the exact evidence page, assignment test, Knowledge Slides, Academy test, OTJ entry, EPA area or monthly portfolio action.
Reviews save with their date, current progress snapshot and a permanent five-target history.
Target reminders repeat weekly on a selectable weekday, defaulting to Monday, until the target is completed.
The next progress review defaults to eight weeks, with optional ten and twelve-week intervals.
ReviewMate targets automatically complete when their required evidence, hours, score, slides, EPA result or portfolio upload is detected, and can also be completed manually.
ReviewMate reminders appear in RemindMate and include their own direct Go to target link.
OTJMate entry lists now show only compact dates until a date is tapped; the same date closes the full entry again.
Manual and automatic Portfolio building OTJ entries use the same accessible expand-and-collapse layout without losing editing, copying, exporting or full detail.
DrawingMate now includes a much larger UK construction reference library covering masonry, structure, timber, ground, finishes, drainage, electrical, fire and general drawing information.
Corrected misleading DrawingMate references including DPC, reinforced concrete, plasterboard, centre-line and UK socket-outlet graphics.

Added UK hatch references for timber end section, plywood, sand, gravel, plaster/render and existing construction, plus common construction symbols such as DPM, spot levels, inspection chambers, RWP, gullies, switches, consumer units, fire doors, wall ties, cavity trays and lintels.
ProjectMate's 440 mm square pier at 9 courses now uses a 51-brick minimum instead of the previous 88-brick quantity.
Generated ProjectMate customers now use £20, £25 or £30 hourly labour rates according to customer urgency, with labour prefilled and realistic material-led budgets and overheads.
RemindMate reminders can now repeat daily, weekly, fortnightly or monthly.
Completing a recurring reminder records the completion and moves it to the next correct future date without creating duplicate reminder cards.
The notification centre now refreshes after app changes, every minute and whenever the app returns to the foreground, so counts and reminder states do not become stale.
Notification categories now surface relevant live actions across assignments, learner progress, OTJMate, RemindMate, ProjectMate, EPA Academy, Knowledge Slides and Certificates.
Added an opt-in Device alerts control for due RemindMate reminders, with service-worker notification handling that returns directly to RemindMate.
CADMate now includes Brickwork, Site Carpentry and Bench Joinery tabs; the two joinery workspaces are clearly marked Coming soon.
Removed the purple ASSESSOR ONLY ribbon from the Learning Outcome Video Walkthrough.
Learning Outcome Learner Statements now require 30 words for every selected Learning Outcome, with the minimum updating live as outcomes are selected.
Removed the unnecessary notes box from Learning Outcome Photographic Evidence while retaining outcome selection, photographs and learner signature.
The main Course title tile is smaller and no longer repeats the standard number, version, level or evidence-pack count.
KSB-course assignment cards now use the single-heading format AS1 - Assignment title.
Learning Outcome course evidence cards now use the matching EP1 - Evidence Pack title format.
Assignment and evidence-pack cards are shorter while retaining all six evidence indicators and every KSB or Learning Outcome coverage marker.
In progress, Evidence ready and Submitted status pills have been removed from assignment cards; completion remains visible through card colour, evidence indicators and RPL markings.
The main navigation is now approximately half its previous height while keeping its labels at the same readable size.
Every phone and tablet screen now reserves the compact navigation footprint, so final controls and page content stop above the bar instead of being covered by it.
The navigation and other floating app controls are completely removed while the video recorder is open, leaving the record button unobstructed in portrait and landscape.
The Course title tile OTJMate shortcut is now fixed to its bottom-left corner and uses the same teal gradient as the OTJMate Toolbox tile.
All in-app video capture now uses a full-screen phone-camera layout that responds cleanly when the phone is turned to landscape.
Recorder controls are compact overlays instead of a large panel, with the record button centred in portrait and moved to the right edge in landscape.
Video Walkthrough questions and criterion wording now sit in a small top prompt drawer that can be expanded or collapsed without covering most of the camera.
The record button now switches clearly between Record and Stop, followed by a full-screen review with Retake and Save controls.
NoteMate, Supporting Evidence and both KSB and NVQ Video Walkthrough recording use the same consistent recorder layout.
Individual RPL now supports selecting and marking multiple KSBs together in one saved action.
The individual RPL checklist and recorded list are ordered numerically as Knowledge, Skills and Behaviours.
Every apprenticeship-standard course now has an OTJMate shortcut directly below its standard number in the Course title tile, including the learner's live OTJ total.
All video recorded inside Apprentice+ now uses a consistent quality-controlled 720p profile at approximately 11 MB per minute.
Professional Discussion and NoteMate voice recordings now use efficient mono speech audio at approximately 0.4 MB per minute.
The Monthly Upload card now estimates the complete portfolio size against a 900 MB safety target and checks the exact ZIP against Aptem's 1 GB limit before download.
Saved video, voice and supporting media now display their actual file size, while gallery videos are clearly identified as original-size files.
Every saved assignment evidence item now adds 0.2 hours automatically to the learner's off-the-job total.
Each separately saved Video Walkthrough criterion also adds its own 0.2-hour Portfolio building record.
OTJMate now has a dedicated Portfolio building section showing the evidence source, date, automatic hours and export status.
Portfolio building records are derived from saved evidence, remain in sync automatically and are kept separate from editable manual OTJ entries.
OTJMate PDF exports and monthly OTJ PDFs contain a clearly labelled Portfolio building section.
Every assignment evidence record page is labelled OFF-THE-JOB - PORTFOLIO BUILDING - 0.2 HOURS.
Monthly portfolio uploads include new Portfolio building records without duplicating records already captured in a confirmed upload.
Saved walkthrough clips and legacy recorded walkthroughs are always included as playable media in assignment and monthly ZIP packages.
Evidence PDFs use one lossless record per submission, with extra pages only for continuation text or the actual submitted media, removing duplicate detail pages.
Photographic evidence now uses the linked KSB or learning-outcome code and official wording in each displayed and exported photo filename instead of the phone's original random filename.
The displayed app version, update metadata and cached asset version have been reset to V1.0.
items: The cumulative RPL, complete evidence PDF, monthly learner progress, Academy activity and combined OTJ features remain included.
Deleting an archived OTJ PDF makes its manual and Portfolio building records available for export again.

releases.title: Individual RPL and Monthly OTJ Portfolio
features: Added individual Recognition of Prior Learning controls for every KSB and NVQ Learning Outcome in each course.
Individual RPL criteria appear purple in Assignments and count as fully completed in evidence coverage and learner progress.
Individual KSB or Learning Outcome RPL is marked with a red RPL label and RPL evidence reference in assignment PDFs.
Assignments completed entirely through RPL receive a large central RECORDED PRIOR LEARNING stamp on every page of their evidence PDF.
Monthly uploads now combine every new OTJ entry for the upload period into one OTJMate Monthly Evidence PDF.
The combined OTJ PDF shows the learner, current total hours, hours required by today and the dates between the previous and current upload.
Removed the redundant separate Contents PDF from each monthly assignment folder because the assignment evidence pack already contains its contents and mapping.
Monthly summaries list new full-assignment and individual-criterion RPL records and include the Academy and learner-progress pages.
Complete learner, witness, employer and assessor details continue to flow across A4 PDF pages without clipping.
items: RPL changes are included in the next monthly delta and invalidate affected assignment upload status.
Assignment folders contain only the evidence pack and any related media files.

releases.title: Complete Portfolio PDF Evidence Records
features: Learner Statement PDF pages now contain the learner's full submitted statement wording.
Added lossless Complete Submitted Details pages for learner, witness, employer and assessor evidence records.
Long statements, observations, summaries, development areas, comments and notes continue onto additional A4 pages instead of being shortened or clipped.
Every selected KSB or Learning Outcome and every awarded score is listed with the submitted evidence record.
Witness and employer identity, role, organisation, activity, testimony, generated feedback, additional comments and signatures are all included.
Practical and assessor records include task details, specification references, all marks, results, feedback, comments, photograph details and signatures.
Photographic evidence now includes notes, selected criteria, file names and saved captions.
Professional Discussion and Video Walkthrough records include the lead, activity, every recording, duration, date, media type and saved notes.
Supporting Evidence is now included in the PDF evidence catalogue with its complete descriptions, mappings, scores and attachment details.
NVQ supporting files are retained as separate files in the downloaded evidence package as well as being listed in the PDF.
items: Normal evidence records are kept to one A4 page where readable; continuation pages are created automatically when needed.
The monthly progress page and Academy Activity PDF from V1.6.36 remain included.

releases.title: Monthly Learner Progress Page
features: Added a full visual Learner Progress page as page 2 of 01 - Monthly Summary.pdf.
The page reproduces the app progress ring with completed KSB or Learning Outcome, collected evidence and time-elapsed rings.
Assignments, KSBs or Learning Outcomes, Off-the-job, Time elapsed and EPA readiness use the same live calculations as the in-app progress panel.
Added the same red, amber and green progress scales, today markers, supporting details and Review status shown in the app.
The progress values are captured when the monthly ZIP is generated, so the PDF reflects the learner’s current position.
items: The V1.6.35 Academy Activity PDF and monthly snapshot logic remain included.
NVQ courses omit EPA readiness in the same way as the live app.

releases.title: Monthly Academy Activity Report
features: Added 02 - Academy Activity.pdf to every monthly upload ZIP.
The PDF lists Academy tests taken during the monthly period with their score, percentage and grade.
Trade Course, Functional Skills, assignment knowledge, EPA Knowledge, Professional Discussion and EPA Practical attempts are included.
Completed Knowledge Slide packs are listed separately with their completion date.
Academy activity is saved in the confirmed monthly snapshot so later uploads include only newly completed activity.
The Monthly Upload card now shows new Academy test and Knowledge Slide totals.
items: The first monthly upload includes all Academy activity already saved on the device.
No existing evidence, OTJMate, RPL or assignment-folder logic was removed.

releases.title: Locked Square Brick Pier Renderer
features: Replaced the previous square-pier geometry with the approved standalone demo renderer.
Pier elevation bricks now retain their fixed 215 mm stretcher and 102.5 mm header face sizes.
Pier Plan Course 1 and Plan Course 2 use the approved alternating perimeter layouts.
The approved pier rules scale from 1×1 through the existing adjustable pier sizes by adding complete fixed-size bricks.
Removed S and H text labels from all pier bricks.
Renamed the pier-only Rear Elevation to Right Elevation.
items: Wall rear elevations remain unchanged.
Metric wall, blockwork and English-bond return renderers were not modified.
The current CADMate PNG export and project save/load features remain available.

releases.title: Adjustable Square Brick Pier Restored
changes: Restored the adjustable square Brick Pier controls to the latest Apprentice+ build.
Wall length now selects square pier sizes from 1 to 16 bricks.
Pier width and depth automatically use the same dimension.
Front, plan, section, technical sheet, quantities and dimensions update with the selected pier size.
Plan Courses 1 and 2 respond to the selected pier size.
Returns remain disabled and Stretcher bond remains selected for Brick Pier construction.
All V1.6.32 recording-format and monthly-upload changes are retained.

releases.title: Recording Format Compatibility
changes: Professional Discussion recordings now use the real media container created by the browser.
Audio exports use matching WebM, OGG, M4A, MP3 or WAV file extensions instead of forcing M4A.
Video Walkthrough exports use matching WebM or MP4 extensions.
Recorded media is checked for a valid container, non-zero size and recording duration before being saved.
Audio and video evidence displays its detected format beside the built-in playback controls.
Monthly assignment folders preserve the correct recording extension for Windows and browser playback.

releases.title: Assignment-Based Monthly Upload Packs
changes: Monthly uploads are now organised into one folder per updated assignment.
Each assignment folder includes Contents.pdf and all related evidence files.
New OTJMate evidence is exported as one PDF per entry in a separate OTJ folder.
Removed unreliable local-file hyperlinks from the monthly summary.
Kept file and folder names short to avoid Windows path-length errors.

releases.title: Compact Linked Monthly Upload Pack
changes: Replaced the separate monthly summary, KSB and OTJ PDFs with one Monthly-Summary.pdf.
Added a clickable evidence index linking to each extracted assignment PDF, audio file and video file.
Shortened the ZIP name, folder paths and media filenames to prevent Windows path-length extraction errors.
The monthly pack now contains only assignments with new evidence or new RPL since the previous confirmed upload.
Included all new OTJMate entries since the previous confirmed upload inside the single monthly summary.

releases.title: CADMate Brick Pier and Display Modes
changes: Renamed Material to Construction and added Brick Pier.
Added isolated simple 1½-brick square pier rendering without changing the existing wall engine.
Disabled returns and locked stretcher bond while Brick Pier is selected.
Added Brick on Edge at 102.5 mm high and rendered Soldier Course on both front and rear elevations.
Applied Bond Detail, Material Hatching and Outline Only consistently across pier front, rear, plan, section and sheet views.

releases.title: Responsive Desktop Information Slides
changes: Information slides automatically switch to a wide two-panel desktop layout while preserving the existing mobile presentation.
Desktop guides show a larger live Apprentice+ preview beside a scrollable explanation panel with persistent navigation controls.
Added Left and Right Arrow keyboard navigation, Escape to close, and backdrop-click closing on desktop.
First-run guided tours now use the same desktop-responsive presentation and remain unchanged on mobile.

releases.title: Automatic Desktop Mode
changes: Automatically enables desktop mode on mouse or trackpad screens at least 960 pixels wide.
Moves the main navigation into a permanent left-hand desktop rail while preserving the existing mobile bottom navigation.
Expands assignment, evidence, Toolbox and Academy grids to use the available desktop width.
Returns to the mobile layout automatically when the browser window is narrowed or opened on a touch-first device.

releases.title: Evidence Progress Rings
changes: Yellow progress now counts every collected evidence slot: 2 per KSB or 3 per Learning Outcome.
KSBs at 1/2 and Learning Outcomes at 1/3 or 2/3 now immediately advance the yellow ring.
Green progress now counts only fully completed KSBs at 2/2 or Learning Outcomes at 3/3.
Repeated KSB codes combine distinct evidence collected across assignments without double-counting the same evidence type.

releases.title: First Sign-In Course and Optional Details
changes: Added the course selector to first sign-in so learners start on the correct course.
Made employer, mentor or assessor, portfolio website, course start date and planned end date visible during signup.
Kept these additional profile fields optional while retaining name, signature and agreement as required.

releases.title: Compact Monthly Upload with OTJMate
changes: Made the monthly portfolio upload card smaller and easier to scan.
Monthly ZIPs now include a separate OTJMate PDF containing only entries added since the last confirmed upload.
The confirmed monthly snapshot now records OTJMate entry IDs to prevent duplicate OTJ evidence in future ZIPs.
Monthly upload stats now show new OTJ entry count and hours.

releases.title: Evidence Controls and Discussion Recorder
changes: Witness testimony S and B scoring now activates immediately after the evidence tick is selected.
Photographic Evidence selections now refresh immediately so photo controls appear without leaving the page.
Practical Assessment 1–5 marking remains locked until the related Skill or Behaviour tick is selected.
Professional Discussion now has separate Start recording and Stop recording controls with a live timer and no pause function.

releases.title: Safe assignment banner removal
changes: Rebuilt from the stable V1.6.18 application code.
Removed the purple Submitted ribbons using isolated styling instead of modifying assignment rendering logic.
Retained RPL, assessor-only and witness-only ribbons, submission records, completion logic and monthly portfolio data.

releases.title: Monthly Portfolio Upload Fixes
changes: Removed the blank browser screen that opened when downloading a monthly portfolio ZIP.
Restored Open Online Portfolio after every successful monthly download.
Restored Evidence Uploaded Online after every successful monthly download, including after earlier confirmed uploads.
Kept the previous confirmed upload date and baseline until the new upload is explicitly confirmed.

releases.title: New evidence stamps for recordings
changes: New video walkthrough files in monthly portfolio ZIPs are prefixed NEW EVIDENCE.
New professional discussion voice recordings are prefixed NEW EVIDENCE.
Attached-media index pages also identify newly added recordings.

releases.title: Practical Assessment Stability
items: Practical scores now update in place without rebuilding or jumping the page.
Assessor comments, photographs and scroll position remain unchanged while marking.
Mobile tap highlights and unwanted focus styling have been removed from score controls.
Assessment summary and development comments update in place only when requested.

releases.title: Learner statements: Knowledge and Behaviours only
items: Learner statements now evidence Knowledge and Behaviour KSBs only.
Skill KSBs have been removed from learner-statement selection.
All photo controls and photo requirements have been removed from learner statements.
Learner-statement PDFs no longer include photo pages.

releases.title: Monthly Upload RPL Update
items: Removed the per-assignment Download Evidence Package workflow.
Monthly portfolio summaries now identify newly awarded Recognition of Prior Learning as RPL units.
Monthly upload confirmation now records included assignments as uploaded online.

releases.title: Monthly Portfolio Uploads
features: Replaced Download Entire Portfolio with a tracked monthly portfolio upload workflow.
Shows the last confirmed upload, additional KSBs met, progress gained and new evidence count.
Creates assignment folders plus front summary and new-KSB PDF documents.
Marks newly added evidence pages with a NEW EVIDENCE stamp.
Opens the learner's online portfolio after download and records Evidence Uploaded Online confirmation.
items: Each ZIP begins with 00 - Monthly Portfolio Update Summary.pdf and 01 - New KSBs Met Since Last Upload.pdf.
Every assignment has its own folder containing its evidence PDF and attached media.
The next monthly comparison starts only after the learner confirms the upload online.

releases.title: Learner-Only Apprentice+
features: Completely removed Assessor Mode from Apprentice+.
Removed the purple assessor theme and Admin Mode application switch.
Removed registers, register templates, attendance records and assessor reports.
Removed assessor workspaces, routes, navigation states and document placeholders.
Restored the permanent three-tab learner navigation: Toolbox, Course and Academy.
items: All learner evidence, EPA, Academy, Toolbox and CADMate features remain available.
Obsolete Assessor Mode and register local-storage keys are deleted when this version starts.
The codebase now operates solely as the Apprentice+ learner application.

releases.title: Apprentice+ Pass and Scanner Removed
features: Removed the Apprentice+ Pass from the learner name tag.
Removed the permanent QR code and eight-digit pass number.
Removed the Assessor Mode camera scanner.
Removed the manual pass-number fallback.
Registers now use manual learner entry and saved register templates only.
Existing locally stored Apprentice+ Pass data is deleted automatically when this version starts.
items: The rest of the Assessor register system remains available.
Historical register attendance records are preserved.
No learner details are encoded into or exposed through a QR code.

releases.title: Assessor Mode Refresh Persistence
features: Assessor Mode now remains active after refreshing, closing or reopening Apprentice+.
The saved purple theme is applied before the first page render.
Assessor register pages can now be restored directly after a refresh.
Invalid learner-page navigation snapshots are ignored while Assessor Mode is active.
Switching back to Apprentice Mode prevents assessor-only pages from being restored.
items: Fixed the issue where the app initially displayed Apprentice Mode until a navigation button was pressed.
Expanded navigation persistence to include Assessor workspace, Reports and all Register pages.

releases.title: Assessor Registers and Pass Scanner
features: Added working register creation, reusable templates and class lists in Assessor Mode.
Added Apprentice+ Pass camera scanning with an 8-digit pass fallback.
First scan signs in and second scan signs out with confirmation.
Added scheduled break deduction and automatic attended-hours calculation.
Added missing sign-out warnings with last-seen time entry.
Added absence reasons, notes, audit history and withdrawn learner handling.
Added register history with date filtering, CSV download and landscape PDF printing.
items: Learner name, course, college, student ID and course dates are read from the permanent Apprentice+ Pass.
All register and learner records are stored locally on the assessor device.
BarcodeDetector camera scanning is used where the browser supports it; manual pass entry remains available.

releases.title: CADMate Landscape PNG Export
features: Replaced the CADMate SVG download with Save PNG.
Added a filename dialog before each drawing download.
Automatically adds the .png file extension.
Exports the current CADMate preview as a 2400 × 1600 landscape PNG.
Exports only the drawing canvas with a white background and no CADMate controls.
Suggests a filename from the selected material, bond, wall length, returns and view.
items: Invalid filename characters are removed automatically.
PNG creation and download remain fully offline.
CADMate project JSON save and load remain available.

releases.title: Working Clean Drawing Viewer
features: Restored the proven technical drawing viewer structure.
Only the drawing and floating close button are visible.
Kept hidden viewer controls in place so zoom and fitting logic continues to function.
Made zoom-label handling safe when optional interface elements are absent.
Kept the viewer fixed and clipped to all four screen edges.
items: Pinch zoom, drag panning, double-tap zoom and boundary locking remain enabled.
Removed visible titles, instructions and toolbars without removing required internal elements.

releases.title: Clean Technical Drawing Viewer
features: Removed all drawing-viewer overlays except the close button.
The landscape screen now shows only the PNG and a small floating X.
Pinch zoom, drag panning, double-tap zoom and edge locking remain active.
items: Removed the drawing title, filename, zoom toolbar, zoom percentage and gesture hint.
Kept the initial rotate-to-landscape prompt.

releases.title: Technical Drawing Edge Lock
features: Fixed the drawing transform origin so the PNG is centred inside the physical screen edges.
Changed the viewer, viewport and screen containers to fixed edge-to-edge rectangles.
Hard-clipped the image stage to the device viewport so no content can sit outside the screen.
Kept pinch zoom, panning and image-boundary clamping.
items: Corrected the missing -50% centring translation that caused the drawing to appear offset.
Added the dedicated viewer to the offline application cache.
Kept all practical assessment content unchanged.

releases.title: Dedicated Technical Drawing Screen
features: Technical drawings now leave the Practical Assessment page and open on a dedicated Apprentice+ viewer screen.
The assessment page can no longer remain visible, scroll or zoom underneath the drawing.
The drawing opens at Fit Width in landscape with custom pinch zoom and edge-clamped panning.
Portrait orientation is blocked until the phone returns to landscape.
Fit Page, Fit Width and 100% controls remain available.
items: Added technical-drawing-viewer.html as a separate offline-cached app screen.
Close returns to the Practical Assessment page using browser history.
Removed the in-page overlay from the active drawing-opening path.

releases.title: True Full-Screen Drawing Viewer Fix
features: Replaced the embedded-looking technical drawing view with a true fixed full-screen viewer.
The drawing now opens at Fit Width so it fills a landscape phone screen.
Browser page pinch zoom is disabled only while the viewer is open.
Drawing controls float over the image instead of reducing the viewing area.
Pinch zoom and panning remain clamped to the PNG boundaries.
items: Requests browser full-screen and landscape orientation when supported.
Restores normal viewport behaviour after closing.
Existing practical assessment drawings remain unchanged.

releases.title: Practical Drawing Viewer
features: Technical drawings now request landscape orientation before opening.
PNG drawings open in a dedicated full-screen landscape viewer.
Added pinch zoom, drag panning, double-tap zoom and mouse-wheel zoom.
Panning is clamped to the drawing edges so learners cannot move into empty space.
Added Fit Page, Fit Width and 100% viewing controls.
Returning to portrait pauses the drawing behind a rotate-to-landscape prompt.
items: Existing Practical Assessment drawings and assessment content remain unchanged.
Zoom is limited from Fit Page to 6×.
The drawing remains in memory while the viewer is open.

releases.title: Apprentice+ Pass Demo
features: Tapping the learner name in Apprentice Mode now opens a full-screen Apprentice+ Pass.
The pass includes the learner name, course, college, student ID when available, and course dates.
An automatic permanent eight-digit pass number is generated and stored on the learner device.
The scannable app-only payload remains fixed after the pass is first issued.
Added a demo panel showing the exact details Assessor Mode will receive.
items: The pass is local-only and does not open a website.
Assessor Mode name tags are unchanged.
